memory_verse.label: Memory Verse
memory_verse.text: "No one engaged in warfare entangles himself with the affairs of this life, that he may please him who enlisted him as a soldier."(2 Timothy 2:4)

devotion.label: Insight / Reflection
devotion.text:
Uriah stands as a shining and noble example of steadfast, disciplined royal loyalty. He was a valiant warrior serving under King David, a man who completely surrendered himself and put his life on the line to fight. Even in the midst of battle, he lived with strict discipline, choosing not to return to his home or his wife.
Although David cunningly orchestrated his death, God did not forget him. God sent a prophet to directly rebuke David and administer righteous judgment. David lost his prestige, and indeed, much of his kingdom's peace.
The righteous God stood by the mighty warrior Uriah. He beautifully etched Uriah's faithfulness into the history of Israel as if carved in stone, exalting him as a true hero.
Similarly, when we stand with unwavering loyalty for the King of kings, even if our good deeds go unnoticed by others, God stands with us and executes justice. Let us remain steadfast in God's battlefield. He sees us, remembers us, answers on our behalf, and brings justice.

quote.label: Today's Quote
quote.text: "God is not unjust to forget your work and labor of love which you have shown toward His name." ( Charles Spurgeon )

prayer.label: Prayer
prayer.text: Lord, make me worthy to stand faithfully and with discipline for You. Grant me the grace to remain faithful even in places where no one sees and in moments when I receive no praise. Keep me from ever turning away from Your battlefield for any reason.

conclusion.label: A Word to You
text: Remain steadfast in your royal loyalty—God will lift you up. In your battles, God Himself will stand with you and fight.
